'''Sector OC-3101''' was an area of space in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] narrowly escaped an attack by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in this sector. The freighter fled to [[Corellia Space Sector IV-3121]], where the ship was rescued by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sector OC-3101 was mentioned by a freighter pilot during the third mission for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] pilot trainer [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''.
